baseline_models.focus_anchor: قالوا تالله تفتؤ تذكر يوسف حتى تكون حرضا أو تكون من الهالكين
baseline_models.mechanism: The collective utterance turns continuous remembrance into an oath-backed causal prognosis with two named terminal states: wasting at the brink and outright destruction.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the collective act that frames the prognosis.
The divine name used in an oath supplies solemn force to the prognosis.
Recall after absence supplies the continuous process that the speakers blame.
Repeated becoming supplies temporal transition into each predicted state.
Melting at the brink of destruction supplies the wasting endpoint.
Falling into destruction and disappearance supplies the terminal alternative.

changed_reading.before: The brothers simply tell the father to stop mentioning Joseph.
changed_reading.after: They solemnize a causal diagnosis: sustained recall will transform his condition into wasting or destruction.

baseline_models.mechanism: Remembrance defeats Joseph's absence by repeatedly restoring him to inward presence, while the speakers construe that same maintenance as dissolving the person who performs it.

activation_trace.role: Heart-held recall supplies Joseph's continued presence despite physical absence.
A reminder that makes something present supplies active maintenance rather than passive feeling.
Dissolution under grief supplies the perceived bodily cost of maintaining presence.

changed_reading.before: Memory is passive attachment to a lost person.
changed_reading.after: Memory is an active presence-maintaining operation whose perceived cost is dissolution of the rememberer.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can stage speech against speech: the group voices an oath to rebuke the father's recurring voicing of Joseph's name, making remembrance a contest over family discourse as well as an inward state.

activation_trace.role: Overt utterance supplies the brothers' collective counter-speech.
Oath usage intensifies their attempt to close the verbal dispute.
Mention on the tongue supplies the live possibility that Joseph is being repeatedly named aloud.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns only private recollection.
changed_reading.after: It may also expose a struggle over whether Joseph's name may remain audible within the family.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حتى تكون حرضا أو تكون من الهالكين
baseline_models.mechanism: The duplicated becoming and the disjunction separate loss of strength and usefulness from outright destruction, so the utterance classifies two feared outcomes instead of merely piling up synonyms.

activation_trace.role: Two occurrences of realized becoming supply a bifurcated state transition.
Weakness and loss of usefulness supply a social-functional collapse short of death.
Destruction and disappearance supply the distinct final outcome.

changed_reading.before: Wasting and death are interchangeable hyperbole.
changed_reading.after: The speakers distinguish disabled survival from final destruction, sharpening their speech into a two-outcome diagnosis.

baseline_models.mechanism: A branch-level reading hears remembrance as repetitive memorial work: it continually restores its object, persists as an occupation, and expends the worker's effort until the work becomes self-consuming.

activation_trace.role: Repeated re-presentation supplies the ongoing task performed by remembrance.
Continuance and persistence in work supply the labor-like duration latent in the focus root.
Exhausting and spending effort supplies the mechanism by which memorial labor consumes its agent.

changed_reading.before: Grief passively happens to the father.
changed_reading.after: The brothers portray remembering as sustained labor that recreates presence while consuming the laborer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier concealment and negated disclosure create a pressure field around Joseph's name. The focus rebuke can therefore function not only as health advice but as an attempt to regulate a memory whose continued presence may make sealed history resurface.

activation_trace.role: Speech used to impose a ruling supplies pressure on another person's practice.
Reminding that restores presence supplies the return of what the group would leave closed.
Hiding something inwardly supplies the sealed side of the pressure mechanism.
Emergence into visibility, explicitly negated there, supplies the disclosure that remains blocked.

structural_cues: 12:77 places a charge about Joseph beside inward concealment and non-disclosure to the brothers.
12:85 again makes Joseph the object of their collective speech, now by regulating the father's remembering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, blocked disclosure, and a later memory-rebuke; I infer that continued remembering may threaten containment. A live alternative is straightforward concern for the father's health.

changed_reading.before: Concerned relatives warn against excessive grief.
changed_reading.after: Their warning may also police a memory whose continued presence presses against an undisclosed history.

context_deltas.mechanism: The elder brother's covenantal refusal to leave until one of two outcomes mirrors the father's non-cessation until one of two outcomes. Persistence is honored as fidelity in the brother but pathologized as wasting in the father.

activation_trace.role: Continuing recall supplies the father's form of steadfast attachment.
Persistence in an occupation supplies a latent durability inside the brothers' negative label.
A confirmed covenant supplies the legitimating reason for the elder brother's persistence.
Prior neglect and loss supply the failure that persistence is meant to repair.
Non-departure under negation supplies the exact staying-until template that mirrors the focus.

structural_cues: 12:80 has فلن أبرح الأرض حتى ... أو ..., while 12:85 has تفتؤ تذكر يوسف حتى ... أو ....
Both constructions hold a present action open until one of two future resolutions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the grammatical mirror, covenant, and prior neglect; I infer a social asymmetry in how endurance is judged. A live alternative is that the shared idiom marks two genuinely costly forms of persistence without exposing hypocrisy.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an unmarked warning about unhealthy duration.
changed_reading.after: It selectively pathologizes the father's fidelity in the same formal shape that had dignified a son's covenantal staying.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sons bound valid assertion to witnessed knowledge and disclaim custody of the unseen, whereas the father claims knowledge beyond theirs. His remembering can preserve a live possibility across the gap left by their visible-evidence regime.

activation_trace.role: Stable inward recall supplies retention of Joseph across evidentiary absence.
Presence with observation supplies the sons' stated evidentiary boundary.
What is hidden from sight supplies the domain their report excludes.
Guarding and preserving, denied of them there, supplies the custody that memory continues to perform.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the explicit asymmetry between the father's knowledge and theirs.

structural_cues: 12:81 contrasts what the sons witnessed and knew with an unseen realm they did not guard.
12:86 answers their prognosis with أعلم ... ما لا تعلمون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit limits on testimony and a later knowledge contrast; I infer that remembrance preserves an unresolved proposition rather than merely repeating a settled loss. A live alternative is that the father's confidence arises independently of memory.

changed_reading.before: Remembering Joseph repeats a known and closed loss.
changed_reading.after: Remembering Joseph preserves a live counter-claim that the brothers' bounded evidence cannot close.

context_deltas.mechanism: Restraint, withdrawal, bodily whitening, and held silence revise the public-mention baseline. Remembrance persists even when speech is contained, with its pressure registered somatically rather than simply broadcast.

activation_trace.role: Heart-held recall supplies a mode of remembrance that need not be spoken.
Holding the self back from panic supplies deliberate emotional containment.
Turning away supplies social withdrawal rather than repetitive public display.
Whitening supplies the visible bodily registration of contained grief.
Holding breath and remaining silent supplies the blocked verbal outlet.

structural_cues: 12:83 names self-restraint before 12:84 turns away, shows whitened eyes from grief, and closes with contained silence.
The brothers' تذكر in 12:85 follows a scene in which one utterance of sorrow coexists with withdrawal and suppression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, withdrawal, bodily change, and silence; I infer that unspoken recall is converted into somatic pressure. A live alternative is that the body registers grief generally, without a specific causal role for remembrance.

changed_reading.before: تذكر chiefly means that the father continually voices Joseph's name.
changed_reading.after: It can mean persistent inward holding that survives curtailed speech and becomes legible in the body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers direct an oath-laden diagnosis at the father; he answers by directing complaint and the disclosure of stored grief to God while asserting differential knowledge. The issue becomes not whether memory speaks, but where and on what epistemic ground it speaks.

activation_trace.role: Collective utterance supplies the family's diagnostic address.
The divine name in their oath supplies the first speech act's solemn framing.
Voicing a remembered person supplies the disputed expressive act.
Making complaint manifest supplies a deliberate channel for grief.
Revealing what was stored in the self supplies release without indiscriminate broadcast.
Knowledge disclosed to its possessor supplies the father's different basis for speaking.

structural_cues: The collective قالوا تالله is answered by the singular إنما أشكو ... إلى الله.
The answer joins directed complaint to an explicit claim of knowledge unavailable to the speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed addressees, disclosed inner grief, and unequal knowledge; I infer that destination changes remembrance from family-bound rumination into selective complaint. A live alternative is that 12:86 is only a defensive reply and not a transformation of memory.

changed_reading.before: Remembering is repetitive speech trapped inside a family feedback loop.
changed_reading.after: Remembering is rerouted into selective disclosure to God, refusing the sons' prognosis without denying grief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next movement converts retained remembrance into sensory investigation, explicitly blocks severed hope, and opens relief. This reverses the brothers' arrow from memory to death into a live sequence from remembered trace to search.

activation_trace.role: Keeping Joseph present supplies the retained trace that can orient a search.
Near-dissolution supplies the terminal trajectory that the following action interrupts.
Destruction supplies the closed endpoint against which search reopens possibility.
Following reports and traces supplies the practical conversion of memory into investigation.
Severance of hope, twice negated, blocks the brothers' terminal closure.
Relief and rest supply the open alternative toward which search is directed.

structural_cues: 12:85 predicts two terminal outcomes; 12:87 instead issues an imperative to investigate Joseph and repeats a ban on despair.
The remembered name in 12:85 becomes the explicit object of search in 12:87.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate sequence, the same absent person, trace-seeking, and negated despair; I infer that remembrance helps preserve the target of action. A live alternative is that the father's stated knowledge, rather than memory itself, is the sufficient trigger.

changed_reading.before: Persistent remembrance is a closed loop that can only consume life.
changed_reading.after: Persistent remembrance is also an archive of presence that can be converted into search, hope, and possible recovery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same collective oath opening returns when the brothers recognize Joseph and admit that they missed the right. The formula that had certified their prognosis becomes a vehicle of self-correction, retrospectively weakening their authority in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Collective articulated speech supplies the first assertion in the echoed formula.
The divine oath supplies the focus assertion's claimed certainty.
The same collective utterance reopens the formula for confession.
Renewed oath usage formally links confession to the earlier prognosis.
Preference by choice supplies their newly confessed valuation of Joseph.
Missing the right supplies explicit acknowledgment that their prior judgments were unreliable.

structural_cues: The first formula predicts the father's ruin; the second confesses Joseph's preference and the speakers' error.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rare verbal echo and explicit admission of error; I infer that the later oath retrospectively undercuts the earlier diagnosis. A live alternative is that the echo marks intensity without specifically recalling 12:85.

changed_reading.before: The oath formula certifies the truth of the brothers' terminal prognosis.
changed_reading.after: The same formula becomes self-correcting speech, exposing confidence in 12:85 as fallible rather than diagnostic authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus projects a one-way bodily transition toward wasting or destruction, but the packet later routes a material trace of Joseph to the impaired face with a projected return of sight. The body becomes a reversible transmission site rather than a terminal sink.

activation_trace.role: Repeated becoming supplies the one-way forecast that the later counter-transition contests.
Bodily dissolution supplies the predicted direction of change.
Whitening supplies the concrete impairment preceding the terminal prediction.
The seeing organ supplies the bodily site whose state can later change.
A worn garment supplies a material trace carried from the remembered person.
Casting and placing supplies the transfer action that delivers the trace.
The face as bodily front supplies the receiving surface.
Ocular seeing supplies the projected restorative endpoint.

structural_cues: 12:84 gives whitened eyes, 12:85 predicts wasting or destruction, and 12:93 routes Joseph's garment to the father's face with projected sight.
The terminal future in the focus is followed by a different bodily future attached to contact with Joseph's trace.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impairment and a material remedial sequence; I infer that the body remains open to reversal rather than merely documenting decline. A live alternative is that Joseph's intervention overrides the prognosis independently of the father's remembering.

changed_reading.before: The body has a one-way trajectory from remembrance to wasting and death.
changed_reading.after: That trajectory is only one projected becoming; a later material relay from Joseph opens a counter-becoming toward sight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the washing-plant and alkali branch is far from the ordinary predication of wasting. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and the immediately preceding whitening of the eyes; downstream prose should present it as a material echo of bleaching or corrosion, not as a replacement translation of حرضا.

activation_trace.role: A washing plant and its alkali supply a bleaching or caustic material analogy inside the focus root.
Literal whitening supplies the adjacent visible effect that activates the material analogy.
The eye as seeing organ supplies the specific surface on which the whitening appears.

changed_reading.before: حرضا names only generalized emaciation near death.
changed_reading.after: Alongside that sense, the adjacency permits an alkali-like bleaching echo in which grief visibly whitens and corrodes the eyes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because حرضا grammatically names depletion, while incitement and persistence are branch-distant countercurrents. The reading remains anchored in the same root and gains an enacted direction from the immediate command to trace Joseph and reject despair; downstream prose should call it latent reversal or foreshadowing, not an alternate lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حرضا within the warning against unceasing remembrance

activation_trace.role: Heating and incitement toward action supply a live reversal within the depletion root.
Persistence in work supplies durable exertion beneath the predicted weakness.
Following a report or trace gives the latent exertion a concrete searching direction.
The twice-negated severance of hope prevents the exertion from collapsing into the predicted endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The focus root marks exhausted incapacity only.
changed_reading.after: Its branch cloud also stores heat and persistence, so the warning inadvertently foreshadows remembrance being mobilized into search.

strongest_changes: The mirrored non-cessation-until constructions in 12:80 and 12:85 expose opposed valuations of persistence.
The evidence contrast in 12:81 and 12:86 recasts remembrance as preservation of a live counter-claim.
The search and anti-despair movement in 12:87 reverses the proposed arrow from memory to death.
The repeated قالوا تالله in 12:91 turns the brothers' certainty into confessed fallibility.
The material route from garment to face and sight in 12:93 weakens the one-way bodily prognosis.
summary.what_was_special: The focus generated several coexisting readings through formal echoes and the unusually reversible branch field of ح ر ض: terminal melting, loss of function, sustained labor, incitement, and even an alkali-whitening analogy. Context did not erase the baseline danger reading; it exposed its social selectivity, epistemic contestability, and capacity to reverse into search and recovery.
remaining_uncertainties: تذكر can remain inward, become audible naming, or move between both; the packet supports but does not settle the distribution.
The concealed-history reading identifies a plausible function of the brothers' rebuke, not a demonstrated motive.
The alkali-whitening and incitement readings are branch-driven echoes and should not be rendered as direct denotations.
The later restorative route may overturn the prognosis through Joseph's intervention without making remembrance itself causally restorative.
